text: FRITSCHLER, CHARLES — Licensed New York Real Estate Broker

Identification is not generally required before receiving brokerage services. Identification may be required for a particular property when requested by a seller, listing broker, building, security personnel, or other lawful third party.

A buyer representation agreement is not required merely to make an inquiry or initially discuss brokerage services. A written buyer representation agreement will be required before a private RLS property showing when required by applicable REBNY/RLS rules.

Neither is generally required before receiving brokerage services. A seller, listing broker, building, or other lawful third party may require pre-approval or proof of funds for a particular property, showing, or offer.
